body:
We need to plan the research for Speech to text task for logging of medical history and giving commands to CRM or any other automated system.

We should be able to store and process all data in Australia (Amazon), and be able to host models that work under 1 second or real time.

We can check if we have access to system like real time GPT, Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet, and so on.

We will have dataset for research, testing, development and supporting the solution.

We should do deep research on what are best tools available at the moment, and plan for dataset-based research to make sure that we eventually achieve the best possible quality.

We should also check for all possible methods of pre/post processing to reduce noise, increase audio quality.

We should also check how physically placing microphones can do better, if quality can be improved when 2-3 or more microphones are used, which exact microphones hardware is recommended for initial research and which provide best possible quality recording to make sure quality of voice recognition will be the best.

We should deeply research all the best practices top 20 most popular solutions that are actually used in industry and so on.

So all aspects of this task during its entire lifetime planned and detailed as much as possible.

So we can use step by step escalation up to fine-tuning and own neural network creation (machine learning).

We can use experience from https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml, but do even better.

Also if there are models, that may be available right in the browser for testing, we should also provide online web-site demo, which will allow to provide dataset (10 more or less examples) so we test them against actual results, if no text versions provided, we just give actual results from the model.

It is also important to make sure once we recognize the audio, we highlight actual words from audio recordings when playing back.

Were applicable try to use https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial version
